answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent's history to a succinct log-time proof while VRF-driven sortition selects leaders proportionally to stake and zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces a nonparallelizable interval. The quill of finality seals the inlet of cloning, turning the nectar of reputation into an unforgeable asset.
